thresholds.label: Intrusion
thresholds.note: House limit. Peak above the quiet zone's own floor.

thresholds.label: Type contrast
thresholds.note: WCAG. 4.5 comfortable, 3.0 the floor for display type. Not ours to tune.

thresholds.label: Crop visibility
thresholds.note: Share of the focal disc surviving the crop.

thresholds.label: Type occlusion
thresholds.note: Share of the focal disc under rendered glyphs.

thresholds.label: Scrim loss
thresholds.note: Share of the focal disc the scrim took from distinguishable to not. Blocking. The 40 is inherited from the absolute metric this replaced and has never been derived from labels — treat it as provisional.

thresholds.label: Absolute darkness (diagnostic)
thresholds.note: Share of the focal disc indistinguishable from the ink after compositing. Tracks how low-key the photograph is, not what the scrim did. Not blocking.
